_note: Plan 39 gate G6. A uniform, opacity or alpha written as `cond ? a : b` in src/scene is a switch in one frame unless something ramps it. Each entry names the site and what drives it. The list only goes down: ease the site (an Eased in src/clock/ease.ts) and delete the entry.

entries.disease/bleed.ts | grow: only on `instant` (reduced motion, a seek or a jump): the eased path is the else branch, which ramps grow and drain
entries.materials/cel.ts | flowBands: a Settings choice (Flow marks: soft bands), set when the choice changes; flow.ts ramps flowAmount (the marks' own fade), so the swap happens at amount 0 or by the owner's own switch
entries.materials/cel.ts | useData: set once when the engine's data texture is bound or released (bindData), never during play
entries.lenses/field.ts | lensRawB: written to side B only; side A keeps its own lensRawA until lensMix reaches 1 (onFrame copies B to A at the start of a fade), so the two sides never share it
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | lensSmooth: a Settings switch (Smooth vessel joins), set for every vessel when the setting changes; it is read by the pressure ramp only and is not written during a lens crossfade
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | nbrOn: set when the vessel is built (a fork's partner is fixed by the anatomy), never changed in play
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | fadeKeep: written with fadeMode by the fade driver (vessels/fades.ts) at the same moment as the eased fade amount's own ramp; the flag only picks which end the fade keeps
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | dotted: presence-track.ts swaps it only at presence amount 0 (the vessel is not drawn at that moment): a closed collateral's ghost
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | smokeOn: set by the stasis slide's setting when its presence is 0 (the smoke's own density ramps)
entries.micro3d/cel3d.ts | uFlowDark: a constant per lobule layer, written every frame with the same value (true for blood and lymph there): it never changes in play
entries.vessels/vessel-object.ts | inkOn: set with dotted (setDotted): presence-track.ts swaps both only at presence amount 0
